images.title: The 40 cm path beats 42 cm
images.purpose: Shows the unfolding of the 30 by 12 by 12 box where the straight line is the side of a right triangle with legs 24 and 32, giving 40 cm.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. One flat net drawn to scale in the centre, faces in pale grey outlines, one bold straight line from ant to laddu and its right triangle legs dashed.
images.exact_structure: Scale 1 unit = 1 cm. Three long faces 30 by 12 stacked in a vertical strip, 30 wide and 36 tall: the ceiling on top, a side wall in the middle, the floor at the bottom. A 12 by 12 end wall is attached to the left short edge of the ceiling, and another 12 by 12 end wall to the right short edge of the floor. All 5 faces have thin grey outlines and white fill. Put the strip's bottom left corner at (0, 0): the ant is a dark dot at (−1, 30), on the left end wall 1 unit from the ceiling edge and midway across it; the laddu is an amber #E69F00 dot at (31, 6), on the right end wall 1 unit from the floor edge and midway across it. A thick reddish purple #CC79A7 straight line joins them, staying inside the net; label it '40 cm'. Two thin teal #0072B2 dimension lines outside the net, with short extension lines: a horizontal one below the net, 3 units under it, spanning x = −1 to x = 31 (the ant's and laddu's x positions), labelled '32 cm'; a vertical one left of the net, 2 units beyond the left end wall, spanning y = 6 to y = 30 (the laddu's and ant's heights), labelled '24 cm'. Near the line in small grey text: 'shorter than 42 cm'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A slanted line over five faces is 40 cm, shorter than the 42 cm direct route, so every unfolding must be compared.
images.description: Shows the unfolding of the 30 by 12 by 12 box where the straight line is the side of a right triangle with legs 24 and 32, giving 40 cm.
images.context: Concept T9.C3; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Legs: 24 = 6 + 12 + 6 and 32 = 1 + 30 + 1. 24² + 32² = 576 + 1024 = 1600, √1600 = 40. Direct route 11 + 30 + 1 = 42. Dimension lines sit outside the net so they never look like a path.

image_decisions.why: The surprise that a route over more faces is shorter can only be seen on the net itself.
